name: Manus Studio
desc: Desktop workspace where people and AI agents share one project.
desc_zh: 让人和 AI 智能体共用同一个项目的桌面工作区
solves: Carrying every capability into every task makes the same work slower and more expensive. Studio brings in only the tools the project actually calls for.
solves_zh: 把全部能力塞进每个任务，只会让同样的活又慢又贵。Studio 只引入项目真正需要的工具。
best_for: One project needs a brief, a page and a video, and you want them to stay one connected job.
best_for_zh: 一个项目同时需要简报、页面和视频，而你希望它们始终是同一件连在一起的活。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://manus.im/blog , then the Manus product menu）。 Announced 2026-09-28 with Manus 2.0. The same post also introduced the Cascade agent framework, the purchasable Cloud Computer and the Cue app. The post says Cascade used 23.2% fewer tokens, finished tasks 28.2% faster and cost 32% less to run in one tested configuration. No media source was read. 首次公开日期来源：https://manus.im/blog/introducing-manus-2-0
